request.style: English, male solo voice with soft choir, piano, cello, strings, ambient pads, reverent and warm, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
As the Father has loved me
So I have loved you
Remain in my love
Keep my commandments
You will remain in my love
Just as I kept the Father's
And remained in his love

[Chorus]
This is my commandment
Love one another as I have loved you
No one has greater love than this
To lay down his life for his friends

[Verse]
You are my friends
If you do what I command you
I no longer call you servants
A servant does not know the master's work
But I have called you friends
For everything from the Father
I have made known to you

[Chorus]
This is my commandment
Love one another as I have loved you
No one has greater love than this
To lay down his life for his friends

[Bridge]
You did not choose me
But I chose you
Appointed you to go
And bear fruit that will last
So that whatever you ask
In my name he will give you

[Chorus]
This is my commandment
Love one another as I have loved you
No one has greater love than this
To lay down his life for his friends

[Outro]
Lay down his life for his friends
